q.en: After rubbing, a neutral plastic rod is negatively charged. What happened?
q.id: Setelah digosok, batang plastik netral menjadi bermuatan negatif. Apa yang terjadi?

why.en: Only electrons transfer when rubbing; the positive atoms stay put. Charge is never created.
why.id: Saat menggosok, hanya elektron yang berpindah; atom positif tetap di tempat. Muatan tidak pernah diciptakan.

q.en: According to the slides, which of these is a conductor?
q.id: Menurut slide, mana yang merupakan konduktor?

why.en: Metals, the human body and tap water conduct; glass, plastic and pure water insulate.
why.id: Logam, tubuh manusia, dan air keran menghantarkan; kaca, plastik, dan air murni mengisolasi.

q.en: A charged rod is brought near an isolated neutral metal sphere. What happens?
q.id: Batang bermuatan didekatkan ke bola logam netral terisolasi. Apa yang terjadi?

options.en: Attraction only if the rod is positive
No force, the sphere is neutral

why.en: Induction puts opposite charge on the near side, which is closer, so attraction wins for either sign.
why.id: Induksi menaruh muatan berlawanan di sisi dekat, yang lebih dekat, jadi tarikan menang untuk tanda apa pun.

q.en: One charge is tripled and the distance between the charges is doubled. The force becomes…
q.id: Satu muatan dilipattigakan dan jaraknya dilipatduakan. Gayanya menjadi…

why.en: F ∝ q₁q₂/r²: × 3 for the charge, × 1/4 for the distance → 3F/4.
why.id: F ∝ q₁q₂/r²: × 3 untuk muatan, × 1/4 untuk jarak → 3F/4.

q.en: What is the correct unit of k in F = k|q₁||q₂|/r²?
q.id: Apa satuan k yang benar pada F = k|q₁||q₂|/r²?

why.en: k = F r²/(q₁q₂) has units N·m²/C². (C²/(N·m²) is the unit of ε₀; the slide's 'C⁻² m²/N' is upside down.)
why.id: k = F r²/(q₁q₂) bersatuan N·m²/C². (C²/(N·m²) adalah satuan ε₀; 'C⁻² m²/N' di slide terbalik.)

q.en: 3-4-5 triangle example: F₃₁ = 1.08 × 10⁻⁸ N (at 37°), F₃₂ = 5.62 × 10⁻⁹ N (along −x). |F₃,net|?
q.id: Contoh segitiga 3-4-5: F₃₁ = 1,08 × 10⁻⁸ N (pada 37°), F₃₂ = 5,62 × 10⁻⁹ N (ke −x). |F₃,net|?

why.en: Fx = F₃₁cos37° − F₃₂ = 3.01 × 10⁻⁹, Fy = F₃₁sin37° = 6.50 × 10⁻⁹ → √(Fx² + Fy²) = 7.16 × 10⁻⁹ N. 1.64 × 10⁻⁸ wrongly adds magnitudes.
why.id: Fx = F₃₁cos37° − F₃₂ = 3,01 × 10⁻⁹, Fy = F₃₁sin37° = 6,50 × 10⁻⁹ → √(Fx² + Fy²) = 7,16 × 10⁻⁹ N. 1,64 × 10⁻⁸ salah karena menjumlahkan besar.

q.en: A point charge is inside a uniformly charged spherical shell. Net force from the shell?
q.id: Muatan titik berada di dalam kulit bola bermuatan seragam. Gaya total dari kulit?

options.en: As if all the shell's charge were at the center
options.id: Seolah seluruh muatan kulit ada di pusat

options.en: Toward the nearest part of the shell

why.en: Shell theorem: inside a uniform shell the net force is zero. 'As if at the center' applies OUTSIDE the shell.
why.id: Teorema kulit: di dalam kulit seragam gaya totalnya nol. 'Seolah di pusat' berlaku di LUAR kulit.

q.en: Which is a possible charge on an object? (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)
q.id: Mana muatan yang mungkin pada suatu benda? (e = 1,6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)

why.en: 3.2 × 10⁻¹⁹ C = 2e. The others are 1.5e, 0.625e and 2.5e, which aren't whole multiples.
why.id: 3,2 × 10⁻¹⁹ C = 2e. Yang lain 1,5e, 0,625e, dan 2,5e, bukan kelipatan bulat.

q.en: Pair production: γ → e⁻ + e⁺. What does charge conservation require?
q.id: Produksi pasangan: γ → e⁻ + e⁺. Apa yang disyaratkan kekekalan muatan?

options.en: Only one electron can be made
options.id: Hanya satu elektron yang bisa dibuat

options.en: Charge is created, so it isn't conserved

why.en: The photon has no charge, and (−e) + (+e) = 0, so the net charge stays 0.
why.id: Foton tidak bermuatan, dan (−e) + (+e) = 0, jadi muatan totalnya tetap 0.

q.en: The electric field at point P is defined as…
q.id: Medan listrik di titik P didefinisikan sebagai…

options.en: The force on any charge placed at P
options.id: Gaya pada muatan apa pun di P

options.en: F/q₀ on a small positive test charge q₀
options.id: F/q₀ pada muatan uji positif kecil q₀

options.en: The charge at P divided by r²
The energy of a test charge at P

why.en: E = F/q₀ with a positive test charge, measured in N/C.
why.id: E = F/q₀ dengan muatan uji positif, bersatuan N/C.

q.en: Electric field lines…
q.id: Garis medan listrik…

options.en: Start on positive charges and end on negative charges
options.id: Berawal di muatan positif dan berakhir di muatan negatif

options.en: Show the path a charge always follows
options.id: Menunjukkan lintasan yang selalu diikuti muatan

why.en: Lines go away from + and toward −; the tangent gives E's direction. They never cross.
why.id: Garis menjauhi + dan menuju −; garis singgung memberi arah E. Garis tidak pernah berpotongan.

q.en: A point charge makes field E at distance r. Field at 3r?
q.id: Muatan titik membuat medan E pada jarak r. Medan pada 3r?

why.en: E ∝ 1/r², so tripling r divides E by 9.
why.id: E ∝ 1/r², jadi r tiga kali membagi E dengan 9.

q.en: Far along its axis (z ≫ d), a dipole's field falls off as…
q.id: Jauh di sumbunya (z ≫ d), medan dipol turun sebanding…

why.en: E ≈ 2kp/z³: the + and − fields almost cancel far away.
why.id: E ≈ 2kp/z³: medan + dan − hampir saling meniadakan di kejauhan.

q.en: Field at the center of a uniformly charged ring?
q.id: Medan di pusat cincin bermuatan seragam?

why.en: E = kqz/(R² + z²)^{3/2} = 0 at z = 0: pieces on opposite sides cancel.
why.id: E = kqz/(R² + z²)^{3/2} = 0 di z = 0: potongan di sisi berseberangan saling meniadakan.

q.en: E points east. An electron in this field feels a force pointing…
q.id: E mengarah ke timur. Elektron dalam medan ini merasakan gaya ke…

why.en: F = qE with q < 0 points opposite to E.
why.id: F = qE dengan q < 0 berlawanan arah dengan E.

q.en: Ink-jet example (m = 1.3 × 10⁻¹⁰ kg, Q = −1.5 × 10⁻¹³ C, vₓ = 18 m/s, L = 1.6 cm, E = 1.4 × 10⁶ N/C). Deflection y?
q.id: Contoh ink-jet (m = 1,3 × 10⁻¹⁰ kg, Q = −1,5 × 10⁻¹³ C, vₓ = 18 m/s, L = 1,6 cm, E = 1,4 × 10⁶ N/C). Simpangan y?

why.en: y = QEL²/(2mvₓ²) = 6.4 × 10⁻⁴ m = 0.64 mm. (The slide prints '0.64 m'.)
why.id: y = QEL²/(2mvₓ²) = 6,4 × 10⁻⁴ m = 0,64 mm. (Slide mencetak '0,64 m'.)

q.en: In the ink-jet, the drop enters twice as fast. The deflection becomes…
q.id: Pada ink-jet, tetes masuk dua kali lebih cepat. Simpangannya menjadi…

why.en: y ∝ 1/vₓ²: half the time between the plates, and the deflection goes with t².
why.id: y ∝ 1/vₓ²: waktu di antara pelat separuhnya, dan simpangan sebanding t².

q.en: A dipole in a uniform field. Which statement is true?
q.id: Dipol dalam medan seragam. Pernyataan mana yang benar?

options.en: Net force 0; torque largest at θ = 90°
options.id: Gaya total 0; torsi terbesar di θ = 90°

why.en: The forces ±qE cancel but form a couple: τ = pE sinθ, largest at 90°. θ = 0° has minimum U (stable); 180° is unstable.
why.id: Gaya ±qE saling meniadakan tetapi membentuk kopel: τ = pE sinθ, terbesar di 90°. θ = 0° punya U minimum (stabil); 180° labil.

q.en: In Φ = EA cosθ, what is θ?
q.id: Pada Φ = EA cosθ, apa itu θ?

options.en: The angle between E and the surface
The angle between E and the surface's normal
options.id: Sudut antara E dan normal bidang

options.en: The angle of the field lines with the x axis
options.id: Sudut garis medan dengan sumbu x

why.en: The area vector A is normal to the surface, so θ is measured from the normal.
why.id: Vektor luas A tegak lurus bidang, jadi θ diukur dari normal.

q.en: A closed cylinder sits in a uniform field parallel to its axis. Total flux?
q.id: Silinder tertutup berada di medan seragam sejajar sumbunya. Fluks totalnya?

why.en: −EA in at one cap, +EA out at the other, 0 through the side. No charge inside, so 0 in total.
why.id: −EA masuk di satu tutup, +EA keluar di tutup lain, 0 di selimut. Tanpa muatan di dalam, totalnya 0.

q.en: E = 3x î + 4 ĵ, cube face at x = 3 m, area 4 m², outward normal +î. Flux?
q.id: E = 3x î + 4 ĵ, sisi kubus di x = 3 m, luas 4 m², normal keluar +î. Fluksnya?

why.en: Only the x-part counts on this face: 3 · 3 · 4 = 36. The 4ĵ part is parallel to the face.
why.id: Hanya komponen x yang dihitung di sisi ini: 3 · 3 · 4 = 36. Bagian 4ĵ sejajar sisi.

q.en: A spherical Gaussian surface around +q doubles in radius. The flux…
q.id: Permukaan Gauss bola di sekitar +q dilipatduakan jari-jarinya. Fluksnya…

why.en: E falls as 1/r² while the area grows as r²: Φ = q/ε₀ for every radius.
why.id: E turun sebanding 1/r² sementara luas naik sebanding r²: Φ = q/ε₀ untuk setiap jari-jari.

q.en: A closed surface encloses +2 nC and −5 nC; a +7 nC charge sits outside. Net flux?
q.id: Permukaan tertutup melingkupi +2 nC dan −5 nC; muatan +7 nC berada di luar. Fluks totalnya?

why.en: Only the enclosed charge counts: (+2 − 5) nC = −3 nC. Outside charges add zero net flux.
why.id: Hanya muatan terlingkupi yang dihitung: (+2 − 5) nC = −3 nC. Muatan di luar tidak menambah fluks bersih.

q.en: +q sits in the cavity of a neutral conducting shell. Charges on the inner and outer surfaces?
q.id: +q berada di rongga kulit konduktor netral. Muatan di permukaan dalam dan luar?

why.en: E = 0 in the metal, so a Gaussian surface there encloses 0: inner wall −q. The shell is neutral, so the outer surface has +q.
why.id: E = 0 di logam, jadi permukaan Gauss di sana melingkupi 0: dinding dalam −q. Kulitnya netral, jadi permukaan luar +q.

q.en: Distance from a long uniformly charged line is halved. E becomes…
q.id: Jarak dari garis bermuatan seragam panjang dibagi dua. E menjadi…

why.en: E = λ/(2πε₀r) ∝ 1/r, so halving r doubles E.
why.id: E = λ/(2πε₀r) ∝ 1/r, jadi r setengahnya membuat E dua kali.

q.en: Uniform solid sphere of radius R. How does E at r = R/2 compare with E at the surface?
q.id: Bola pejal seragam berjari-jari R. Bagaimana E di r = R/2 dibanding E di permukaan?

why.en: Inside, E = kqr/R³ grows linearly with r: at R/2 it is half the surface value kq/R².
why.id: Di dalam, E = kqr/R³ naik linear terhadap r: di R/2 nilainya setengah dari nilai permukaan kq/R².

q.en: Sphere (R = 5 cm) inside a neutral conducting shell (10–15 cm). Rank E at A (4 cm), B (8), C (12), D (16).
q.id: Bola (R = 5 cm) di dalam kulit konduktor netral (10–15 cm). Urutkan E di A (4 cm), B (8), C (12), D (16).

why.en: In units of kq/cm²: A = 0.032, B = 0.0156, D = 0.0039, C = 0 (inside the metal).
why.id: Dalam satuan kq/cm²: A = 0,032, B = 0,0156, D = 0,0039, C = 0 (di dalam logam).

q.en: Which statement about electric potential V is true?
q.id: Pernyataan mana tentang potensial listrik V yang benar?

options.en: V is a vector pointing along E
V is potential energy per unit charge, a scalar
options.id: V adalah energi potensial per satuan muatan, skalar

options.en: V is the force on a test charge
options.id: V adalah gaya pada muatan uji

why.en: V = U/q, measured in volts (J/C). It is a scalar; N/C is the unit of E.
why.id: V = U/q, bersatuan volt (J/C). V skalar; N/C adalah satuan E.

q.en: An electron is moved by the field so that the field does positive work. Its potential energy…
q.id: Elektron dipindahkan medan sehingga medan melakukan usaha positif. Energi potensialnya…

why.en: ΔU = −W. Positive work by the field means U decreases (Example 1: ΔU = −1.2 × 10⁻¹⁴ J).
why.id: ΔU = −W. Usaha positif oleh medan berarti U turun (Contoh 1: ΔU = −1,2 × 10⁻¹⁴ J).

q.en: An electron and a proton are each accelerated from rest through 100 V. Which is true?
q.id: Elektron dan proton masing-masing dipercepat dari diam melalui 100 V. Mana yang benar?

options.en: Same kinetic energy; the electron is much faster
options.id: Energi kinetik sama; elektron jauh lebih cepat

options.en: Same kinetic energy; the proton is faster
options.id: Energi kinetik sama; proton lebih cepat

why.en: Both gain |q|ΔV = 100 eV. v = √(2qΔV/m): 5.9 × 10⁶ m/s for the electron, 1.4 × 10⁵ m/s for the proton.
why.id: Keduanya mendapat |q|ΔV = 100 eV. v = √(2qΔV/m): 5,9 × 10⁶ m/s untuk elektron, 1,4 × 10⁵ m/s untuk proton.

q.en: How are equipotential surfaces related to the electric field?
q.id: Bagaimana hubungan permukaan ekuipotensial dengan medan listrik?

why.en: Moving along an equipotential takes no work, so E has no component along it: E ⊥ surface, pointing toward lower V.
why.id: Bergerak di sepanjang ekuipotensial tanpa usaha, jadi E tidak punya komponen di sepanjangnya: E ⊥ permukaan, menuju V lebih rendah.

q.en: Uniform field E; points i and f are d apart along a field line. V_f − V_i via a bent path?
q.id: Medan seragam E; titik i dan f berjarak d sepanjang garis medan. V_f − V_i melalui lintasan berbelok?

options.en: −Ed, the same as the straight path

why.en: ΔV = −∫E·ds is path independent; both paths in Example 3 give −Ed.
why.id: ΔV = −∫E·ds tidak bergantung lintasan; kedua lintasan di Contoh 3 memberi −Ed.

q.en: Point charge q. At distance 2r, the potential compared with at r is…
q.id: Muatan titik q. Pada jarak 2r, potensialnya dibanding pada r adalah…

why.en: V = kq/r falls as 1/r (it's E that falls as 1/r²).
why.id: V = kq/r turun sebanding 1/r (E yang turun sebanding 1/r²).

q.en: 12 electrons on a ring are moved from evenly spaced to bunched in a 120° arc. At the center…
q.id: 12 elektron pada cincin dipindahkan dari merata menjadi berkumpul di busur 120°. Di pusat…

options.en: V and E both stay the same
V stays −12ke/R; E changes from 0 to non-zero
options.id: V tetap −12ke/R; E berubah dari 0 menjadi tidak nol

why.en: V depends only on distances (all still R). E is a vector sum, which no longer cancels.
why.id: V hanya bergantung pada jarak (semuanya tetap R). E adalah jumlah vektor, yang tidak lagi saling meniadakan.

q.en: A charged conducting sphere (radius R, charge q). V at its center?
q.id: Bola konduktor bermuatan (jari-jari R, muatan q). V di pusatnya?

why.en: E = 0 inside, so V doesn't change: it stays at the surface value kq/R. E = 0 doesn't mean V = 0.
why.id: E = 0 di dalam, jadi V tidak berubah: tetap bernilai permukaan kq/R. E = 0 tidak berarti V = 0.

q.en: In a region V(x) decreases steadily as x increases. Which way does E point?
q.id: Di suatu daerah V(x) turun terus saat x bertambah. Ke mana arah E?

why.en: Eₓ = −dV/dx. V falling means dV/dx < 0, so Eₓ > 0: E points downhill, toward +x.
why.id: Eₓ = −dV/dx. V turun berarti dV/dx < 0, jadi Eₓ > 0: E menuruni bukit, ke +x.

q.en: q₁ = +q, q₂ = −4q, q₃ = +2q, each pair d = 12 cm apart, q = 150 nC. System potential energy?
q.id: q₁ = +q, q₂ = −4q, q₃ = +2q, tiap pasangan berjarak d = 12 cm, q = 150 nC. Energi potensial sistem?

why.en: U = k(q₁q₂ + q₁q₃ + q₂q₃)/d = k(−4 + 2 − 8)q²/d = −10kq²/d = −17 mJ.
why.id: U = k(q₁q₂ + q₁q₃ + q₂q₃)/d = k(−4 + 2 − 8)q²/d = −10kq²/d = −17 mJ.
